name: Monte-Carlo BSSRDF Simulation
definition: A Monte-Carlo simulation to compute the BSSRDF $S(r, 	heta_s, 	heta_i, 	heta_o, 	heta_o)$ for spatially uniform, homogeneous materials with an infinite plane boundary, reducing dimensions to relative spatial positions and angles.
summary: Monte-Carlo BSSRDF Simulation computes sub-surface scattering for homogeneous materials by explicitly tracing photon paths, capturing single and multiple scattering effects more accurately than analytical diffusion approximations.
